145.news_title: Arcade Machine Bezels and LCD Mounting Kits
145.long_description:
We are working hard to have a full range of arcade machine mounting brackets and mini bezels kits as part of our 4:3 arcade LCD monitor release. Save time and money with a plug and play solution to replace your old worn/broken arcade crt tube monitors in your arcade machine. Soon, you will be able to choose the arcade machine name on the Arcooda website, where it will show you;
  • the matching Arcooda LCD 4:3 monitor suitable to replace the CRT
  • the matching mounting bracket
  • the matching mini bezel (to solve the gap that is left when the CRT is replaced with flat monitor)
  • (and depending on demand), a mini harness to plug straight into the Sega, Namco, etc RGB wiring system.
    • Thanks to the support of our customers and friends who are sending us bezel sizes and monitor mounting frame sizes. With your continued help we plan to have a solution for as many arcade cabinets as possible. To work with us for solutions, please contact our team at sales@arcooda.com.
